    Load example seabORD model output

    get_example_output.Rd

    Retrieves a precomputed seabORD model-output object for use in package examples, vignettes, plotting functions, and testing workflows.

    Usage

    get_example_output(type = NULL)

    Arguments

    type

    Character string specifying the example output to load. Available options are:

    • NULL: Output from the standard scenario example.

    • "cal": Output from the standard calibration example.

    • "cal_dd": Output from the density-dependence calibration example.

    Value

    A precomputed seabORD model-output object. Its contents depend on the selected example and may include adult, chick, flight, survival, impact, parameter, and spatial output components.

    Details

    This function provides access to precomputed model outputs so that examples and vignettes can demonstrate output processing and plotting without rerunning the complete simulation.

    The structure of the returned object corresponds to the output produced by seabord(), although individual components depend on the model mode and output switches used when the example was generated.

    See the package output vignette for guidance on examining and plotting seabORD results: vignette("I_exampleKI_output", package = "seabORD").

    See also

    seabord() and get_example_par().

    Other example data: get_example_DBS_map(), get_example_ORDpoly(), get_example_fgc_3035(), get_example_fltdist_base(), get_example_frgcompdata(), get_example_modpar(), get_example_ordPar(), get_example_par(), get_example_seamask(), get_example_spadat1(), get_example_spadat2(), get_example_spdat(), get_example_switches()

    Examples

    # Load the standard scenario output
output <- get_example_output()

# Load the standard calibration output
calibration_output <- get_example_output("cal")

# Load the density-dependence calibration output
calibration_output_dd <- get_example_output("cal_dd")

# Inspect the top-level output components
names(output)
#>  [1] "switches"      "Parameters"    "ordPar"        "modPar"       
#>  [5] "thisRun"       "output_f0"     "output_c0"     "output_a0"    
#>  [9] "output_y0"     "BirdFlightMap" "output_i0"     "output_i1"    
#> [13] "output_i2"     "output_i3"     "output_i4"     "output_i5"
